en.title: Izmir's transition to AKP receives global media attention
en.summary: The switch of Izmir Mayor Cemil Tugay to the ruling AKP party has generated significant international media coverage from outlets including Reuters and AP.

en.summary: Izmir Mayor Cemil Tugay's joining the AKP drew widespread international coverage, with major outlets noting the party gained control of the city's mayoralty through his party switch rather than elections.

en.summary: Turkey's Defense Ministry confirmed discussions on deploying military forces and capabilities to Saudi Arabia within constitutional and legal frameworks following the alliance's latest meeting.

en.summary: Following four consecutive match defeats, coach Vincenzo Montella's position with Turkey's national football team is reportedly under scrutiny, with Italian media suggesting Arda Turan as a possible successor.

en.summary: Seven people, including deputy mayors of Silifke Municipality in Mersin, were detained on suspicion of irregularities in zoning and licensing procedures.

en.summary: Three stories of a seven-story building collapsed in Maltepe, killing one person and injuring ten others, including three children, who were rescued by firefighters.

en.summary: Italian media reports claim that Turkey's Football Federation will appoint Arda Turan as national team coach following Vincenzo Montella's departure due to poor results.

en.title: KVKK warns employers on email monitoring: No unlimited access to correspondence
en.summary: Turkey's data protection authority established new rules restricting employers' monitoring of corporate emails and communications assigned to employees, requiring prior notification to workers about monitoring scope and methods.

en.summary: A Federal Reserve Board member stated in Istanbul that additional interest rate increases may be necessary to control inflation, though consecutive increases are not mandatory, with market attention shifting toward December decisions.

en.title: AJet launches winter campaign: International flight tickets starting from 19 dollars
en.summary: AJet began a winter promotional campaign offering limited seats on international flights, with tickets departing Turkey starting at 19 dollars and selected flights arriving in Turkey from 9 euros.

stories.title: AKM’de engelleri aşan “Erişilebilir Tiyatro” yeni sezonda da perdelerini açıyor

en.title: "Accessible Theatre" Overcomes Barriers at AKM, Opening Again in New Season
en.summary: Turkish Telekom's "Accessible Theatre" project, designed to make culture and arts available to everyone, returns at AKM for the new season. The initiative aims to increase participation of visually and hearing-impaired individuals in cultural events, with the season opening on October 9 and additional performances scheduled.
